note: Test reply (illustrative, not history): an audience with Bartenstein on the 24th, shown in the post that day; Glogau campaigning while Vienna is in winter quarters. Load with __w3d.mockReply('meeting').

changes.title: An audience with the secretary
changes.briefing: Bartenstein received you on the 24th. Glogau's garrison reports the Prussian outposts close.

reports.title: Glogau stands to arms
reports.text: Wallis writes that the garrison at Glogau keeps its works manned day and night.

scene.title: Bartenstein at the Chancellery
scene.setting: The secretary's room at the Chancellery, late morning. Papers on every chair.

lines.text: You put the case for sending the two regiments north before the roads close.
The Conference will hear it on Thursday. I will not promise you more than a hearing.
Then let it be Thursday, and let the orders be drafted before it sits.
Drafted, yes. Signed is another matter.

commitments: Bartenstein will put the regiments before the Conference on Thursday
Orders to be drafted in advance

hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: an audience with Bartenstein.

decisions.knows: The regiments are wanted in Silesia.
